## Checklist

### Author

- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New code has tests (when applicable)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or credentials in code
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)

### Reviewer

- [ ] Code follows project conventions (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No security issues (auth checks, input validation, XSS, injection)
- [ ] Error handling is appropriate (no swallowed errors)
- [ ] No unnecessary `console.log` or debug code
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior
- [ ] Changes are scoped — no unrelated changes mixed in
- [ ] PR is a reasonable size (< 500 lines)
